title: A Study of Eloralintide (LY3841136) in Participants with Obesity or Overweight, and Type 2 Diabetes (ENLIGHTEN-2)
official: J3R-MC-YDAF - A Phase 3 Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study to Investigate the Efficacy and Safety of Once Weekly Eloralintide in Adult Participants with Obesity or Overweight, and Type 2 Diabetes
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate that eloralintide is superior to placebo for change in body weight.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Have type 2 diabetes
2. Be on stable treatment for type 2 diabetes
3. Have a BMI ≥ 27 kg/m2
4. Have a stable body weight (<5% body weight change) for 90 days prior to screeninG
Exclusion criteria:
1. Participants must not have had or are planning to have surgery, an endoscopic procedure, and/or device-based therapy for weight loss (with exceptions)
2. Have type 1 diabetes
3. Have taken certain medications for blood sugar within 90 days prior to screening
4. Have had a serious heart condition within 90 days prior to screening
5. Have taken medications or alternative remedies intended for weight loss within 90 days prior to screening
